race.comment: Deep maiden but ZAMBALES (14) will take plenty of beating. He was beaten at $1.65 fresh but just couldn't quicken well enough over the 1200m and the winner there was an absolute tragedy beaten next time out in a good form race. Extra 100m suits nicely and if he's ridden positively he can break through. SANTA BARBARA (15) was good on debut before being pitched into the G3 Quezette at Caulfield and struggling behind star filly Natural Fling. This suits better up in trip and she can bounce back. SALANN (13) resumes having shown plenty of talent in two runs to date, in a G3 on debut and then very good in the Fernhill at Randwick. Wary albeit she'll be giving them a start. WRITTEN EMPIRE (10) is a well bred colt for the Hayes yard who warrants plenty of respect, as does TRUE REBEL (9) for the O'Brien yard off a good jumpout win.
